template.name: Turtle Trader SAR
template.notes: The documented entry and exit rules are used directly: a close above the prior ShortPeriod 20 Donchian high enters long and the opposite ExitPeriod 10 low break exits. ATR(20) stop and take levels (StopAtr/TakeAtr 1), LongPeriod 55, pyramiding AddInterval, ATR risk sizing and the optional Parabolic SAR trail have no percentage or position-layer equivalent in the DSL.
